item_name: Percent Intake by Artificial Route — Proportion of Total Calories the Resident Received through Parenteral or Tube Feeding

lookback_source.quote: Review intake records within the last 7 days to determine actual intake through parenteral or tube feeding routes.

lookback_notes: The Steps for Assessment direct review of intake records within the last 7 days. The item form on p. K-15 defines two columns with distinct periods: Column 2, "While a Resident — Performed while a resident of this facility and within the last 7 days," and Column 3, "During Entire 7 Days — Performed during the entire last 7 days." The manual pages supplied do not state the exact counting convention relative to the ARD.

coding_levels.label: 25% or less
coding_levels.definition: Proportion of total calories the resident received through parenteral or tube feeding is 25% or less.

source.quote:
Select the best response:
1. 25% or less

coding_levels.label: 26% to 50%
coding_levels.definition: Proportion of total calories the resident received through parenteral or tube feeding is 26% to 50%.

coding_levels.label: 51% or more
coding_levels.definition: Proportion of total calories the resident received through parenteral or tube feeding is 51% or more.

federal_coding_rules.rule: Complete K0710 (including K0710A) only if Column 2 and/or Column 3 are checked for K0520A and/or K0520B.

source.quote: Complete K0710 only if Column 2 and/or Column 3 are checked for K0520A and/or K0520B.

federal_coding_rules.rule: Review intake records within the last 7 days to determine actual intake through parenteral or tube feeding routes, then calculate the proportion of total calories received through these routes.

source.quote: 1. Review intake records within the last 7 days to determine actual intake through parenteral or tube feeding routes. 2. Calculate proportion of total calories received through these routes.

federal_coding_rules.rule: If the resident took no food or fluids by mouth or took just sips of fluid, stop and code 3, 51% or more.

source.quote: If the resident took no food or fluids by mouth or took just sips of fluid, stop here and code 3, 51% or more.

federal_coding_rules.rule: If the resident had more substantial oral intake than sips of fluid, consult with the qualified dietitian or other clinically qualified nutrition professional.

source.quote: If the resident had more substantial oral intake than sips of fluid, consult with the qualified dietitian or other clinically qualified nutrition professional.

federal_coding_rules.rule: Select the best response among 1 (25% or less), 2 (26% to 50%), and 3 (51% or more).
Column 2 captures intake performed while a resident of this facility and within the last 7 days; Column 3 captures intake performed during the entire last 7 days.

source.quote: 2. While a Resident ... Performed while a resident of this facility and within the last 7 days

federal_coding_rules.rule: Compute the percentage as total calories received by tube/parenteral route divided by total calories (oral plus tube) received over the 7 days, and code the resulting percentage band (example: 15,000/17,450 = 85.9% → code 3).

source.quote: Calculation of the percentage of total calories by tube feeding: 15,000/17,450 = .859 X 100 = 85.9%

federal.criterion: Intake records for the last 7 days documenting actual calories received through parenteral or tube feeding routes (and oral intake) sufficient to calculate the proportion.

source.quote: Review intake records within the last 7 days to determine actual intake through parenteral or tube feeding routes.

federal.notes: The manual directs the assessor to base coding on review of intake records.

federal.criterion: Dietitian (or other clinically qualified nutrition professional) input/calorie totals when oral intake is more than sips of fluid.

source.quote: If the resident had more substantial oral intake than sips of fluid, consult with the qualified dietitian or other clinically qualified nutrition professional.

federal.notes: Framed as a required consultation step in the assessment; the example on p. K-17 shows the dietitian totaling calories per day.

federal.criterion: Evidence that K0520A and/or K0520B is checked in Column 2 and/or Column 3, establishing that K0710 should be completed.

source.quote: Complete K0710 only if Column 2 and/or Column 3 are checked for K0520A and/or K0520B.

case_mix_relevance.notes: The supplied pages for K0710A do not explicitly tie this item to a payment or case-mix classification. The related item K0520 references the SNF PPS Stay and the Interim Payment Assessment (p. K-11, p. K-12), but no such statement appears for K0710A.

positions.claim: Steps for Assessment state a single review window: intake records within the last 7 days.

source.quote: Review intake records within the last 7 days to determine actual intake through parenteral or tube feeding routes.

positions.claim: The item form specifies two distinct columns/periods: Column 2 (performed while a resident of this facility and within the last 7 days) and Column 3 (performed during the entire last 7 days), which can yield different codes.

source.quote: 3. During Entire 7 Days ... Performed during the entire last 7 days

conflicts.resolution: unresolved — surface to user; note the K0710B example on p. K-19 demonstrates that Column 2 and Column 3 can be coded differently, implying both windows apply per column.

not_found: lookback counting convention relative to the ARD
